def min_swaps_to_transform(p, s):
    n = len(p)
    pos = {value: idx for idx, value in enumerate(p)}
    swaps = []
    coins = 0

    for i in range(n):
        if p[i] != s[i]:
            # Find the position of the element that should be at position i in s
            correct_pos = pos[s[i]]
            # Swap the elements
            p[i], p[correct_pos] = p[correct_pos], p[i]
            # Update the positions
            pos[p[i]] = correct_pos
            pos[p[correct_pos]] = i
            # Add the cost of the swap
            coins += abs(i - correct_pos)
            # Record the swap
            swaps.append((i + 1, correct_pos + 1))

    return coins, swaps
